bullets: **企业落地**：这条更新把重点放在 ==Claude 接入核心系统==，而不是单个模型参数或榜单指标。

builder_observations.author: Madhu Guru
builder_observations.content: 从 Gemini 早期开始，企业在质量与成本取舍上常会一开始选最小、最便宜的模型。给客户的经验法则是：如果用 LLM 替换已有传统机器学习模型，可以先从小模型开始，因为你已经知道好结果是什么；如果是在构建新应用，先用最强模型探索上限，做出高质量应用后，再逐步迁移到更小模型。
builder_observations.original_text: Right from the early days of Gemini, enterprises would get the quality/cost tradeoff wrong. They’d often start with the smallest, cheapest model. The rule of thumb we gave customers: Replacing a traditional ML model with an LLM - start small, cos you already know what good looks like. Building something new - start with the most capable model. Think magically. Figure out what’s actually possible first. Once they had a high-quality working application, we’d help them move to a smaller model whil...
